admission: One source-supported historical neighborhood perimeter candidate; current/legal/address status unverified.
method: Official 2013 perimeter text interpreted as an ordered road-centreline circuit on actual 2026 OSM node geometry. Every junction is the unique shared OSM node of successive named roads; every edge is consecutive in an original OSM way. No inferred connectors or geometry repair.
attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; perimeter facts: Szombathely MJV IVS annex1,2013-06-06
sourceDocumentRightsStatus: Publicly accessible municipal PDF; no explicit open redistribution licence independently verified. ODbL geometry licence does not apply to municipal PDF.

limits: The PDF describes an actual named residential quarter, rather than an action area or multi-quarter planning cluster.
Source normalizations: Hámor u. -> Hámor utca; Vas u. -> Vas utca; source typo Akotás u. -> Alkotás utca.
The repeated Zanati út segments are retained in their specified order and form the southern projection visible on source map page50, quarter15.
The 480x476-pixel source map was visually checked only as a coarse topology/name check; no map pixels contribute coordinates.
Road centrelines are an interpretation of textual road boundaries. Parcel-side inclusion, current legal status and address assignment are not verified.
